difficulty_reason: For a connected Noetherian scheme X with dualizing module omega_X, the lemma asserts that the support of omega_X is the union of the irreducible components of maximal dimension with respect to any dimension function, and that omega_X is a coherent module having property (S_2) (statement lines 6100-6122). By the conventions discussed above there is a dualizing complex omega_X^bullet whose leftmost nonvanishing cohomology sheaf is omega_X, and since X is connected any two dimension functions differ by a constant by Topology, Lemma labelled topology-lemma-dimension-function-unique, so one may use the dimension function associated to omega_X^bullet from Lemma labelled lemma-dimension-function-scheme (proof lines 6124-6134). The lemma then follows from Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-depth-dualizing-module together with the definitions, in particular Cohomology of Schemes, Definition labelled coherent-definition-depth (proof lines 6134-6140). Using connectedness to pin down the dimension function so that the algebraic depth statement applies is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
